text: 16 York Street is a 32-storey office building with retail at grade under construction on the south-west corner of Bremner Boulevard and York Street. City Council approved re-zoning for the development in 2009 (Site Specific Zoning By-law 494-2009) following a comprehensive review process including close engagement from area stakeholders including the York Quay Neighbourhood Association (YQNA). On April 25, 2018, the Committee of Adjustment approved variances to permit a reduction in the proportion of street-related retail uses along the building face and specifically on Bremner Boulevard. These requirements were originally put in place in order to ensure the street walls along Bremner Boulevard and York Street are animated, interesting to walk by, and encouraging "eyes on the street" from inside and from the sidewalk. City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the City Solicitor to appeal the April 25, 2018 Decision of the Toronto and East York Committee of Adjustment regarding 16 York Street (Municipal File A1321/17TEY) to the Toronto Local Appeal Body. 2. City Council authorize the City Solicitor and appropriate staff to attend the Toronto Local Appeal Body to oppose the Committee of Adjustment's Decision to approve the minor variances respecting 16 York Street. 3. City Council authorize the City Solicitor to settle the matter on behalf of the City at the discretion of the City Solicitor, after consultation with the Ward Councillor.
